sections.heading: Bug Fixes
lines: Fixed issue where JEI and certain GUI interfaces were too small
Fixed FTB permission issue with Cloud Pattern Repository
Fixed issue where cross-recipe type parallel machines did not support multiple pattern providers
Fixed flickering preview when paging through multiblock structures

sections.heading: Mechanic Changes
lines: Optimized private dimension 'Natural Forest Lake Park'
Optimized Central Teleporter performance and interaction
Added search functionality to Central Teleporter

sections.heading: Quests
lines: Central Pattern Repository changed to free reward at ULV stage

sections.heading: Notice
lines: Players who created the Natural Forest Lake Park preset dimension in version 3.0
have permanently lost Central Teleporter functionality (cannot be fixed in existing save), using Teleport Anchor is recommended
New worlds created in 3.1 are unaffected. As compensation, Central Pattern Repository has been moved to ULV gift
After all, it is all central...
